text:
alex: Quick delivery sync — short async thread for Optimize toolkit checkpoint. main asks: owners, blockers, CI/regressions, and CR pings. can we lock canary milestone?

maria: I own quant recs. draft profiles pushed to //repo/optimize/quant-profiles (PR #4312). need benchmark numbers vs q4_4 and 8-bit by EOD.

pranav: I'll take batching/caching suggestions and update the batching config RFC. heads-up: change touches request router; might need runtime review.

kyle: I'll own the rollout policy/canary. plan: 10% traffic for 48h -> 50% -> 100%. need fallback mapping to smaller model.

tao: @pranav ping me on the router PR, I'll review for latency regressions. small note: please include perf tags in the PR (seq_len distributions).

sam: For regression harness, recommend using: 1) internal microbench suite; 2) 3 customer prompt sets (search, chat, completion); 3) slice with long-context. jen has the sets.

jen: Confirmed — adding the customer prompt sets to PR test matrix. also add a smoke test for prefix cache hits.

alex: Important: saw a latency spike on dev canary overnight (0800 UTC). CI logs show KV cache miss rate jumped. snippet from staging logs:```
[2026-03-14T08:03:21Z] INFO kv_cache: miss_rate=0.42 seq_len_p95=204
[2026-03-14T08:03:22Z] WARN routing: batch_size=1 path=slow_kernel
```
Can someone triage root cause? could be batching policy fallback.

pranav: Noted — I suspect an autoscale/throttling interaction with new batching window. will add diagnostics to the router and run a replay.

maria: Also running quant bench now; if quantization reduced KV cache locality, that'll show in the replay. sending preliminary numbers in ~3h.

deploy-bot: buildbot: PR #4312 build passed. staging tests: 214/216 passed. failing tests: cache_hit_smoke (flaky).

ci-bot: perf-ci: nightly regression alert triggered: +18% p95 token latency on staging-canary. link: https://ci.redwood/investigate/2201

kyle: Given the alert, we'll pause the canary rollout until blockers cleared. can someone add a short postmortem note in the canary run doc? 

alex: Action items: 1) @maria continue bench and post numbers; 2) @pranav add router diagnostics and replay; 3) @tao review runtime PR and perf tags; 4) @kyle hold rollout and prepare fallback mapping; 5) @jen add prompt sets and smoke test. please update this thread when done.

maria: Will update — if 8-bit wins for latency but loses quality on a customer slice, we'll recommend hybrid: quant for high-throughput routes, fp16 for latency-sensitive routes.

tao: Reviewing PRs now, scheduling quick review slot at 10:30 PT. will annotate perf-critical lines.

pranav: Started a replay job against the dev trace; ETA 1.5h. I added `router.debug=true` on the staging canary so logs will include batch windows.

sam: CR ping: @maria can you add a short test plan to PR #4312 (what to run and pass criteria)? @tao please review router PR: #4320.

maria: Added test plan to PR and linked the customer prompt set. cc @jen.

kyle: I posted the fallback mapping doc under //docs/rollouts/optimize-fallback.md. please add comments.

jen: Smoke test flakiness tracked as issue #556. I'll queue flakiness mitigation this sprint.

alex: Timeline check — if benches + replay finish today and no new regressions, target canary restart tomorrow 2026-03-15 06:00 UTC. prod goal 2026-04-01. confirm dependencies on eng-infra for new instance type?

pranav: Yes infra needs to spin up the new c6g-highmem variant for replication testing. pinging @infra (cc eng-infra channel).

tao: One more request: add perf histogram to the canary dashboard for quick comparisons (p50/p95/p99 + kv_cache_miss). I can help with the dashboard query.

maria: Preliminary bench: q4_4: throughput +23%, p95 +12% latency; 8-bit: throughput +18%, p95 +8% latency. quality diffs minimal on majority slices, one customer slice dropped BLEU by 3.6. uploading detailed CSV soon.

alex: Thanks all. small ask — everyone, drop a one-line update in this thread when your item is done so we can close the loop. :thumbsup:

tao: Reviewed router PR, left two comments. will +1 after address.

maria: Bench numbers uploaded and linked in PR. quality diff flagged on slice "long-form-rewrite".

pranav: Replay run completed, root cause was batching window shrinking under low concurrency -> more single-item batches. pushing fix to respect min_batch=4.

jen: Flakiness mitigation PR opened (#4326).

kyle: Fallback mapping finalized. ready to restart canary when infra confirms instance availability.

infra: infra-bot: c6g-highmem spins scheduled for 2026-03-15 02:00 UTC in staging region.

alex: Great — looks like all blockers are owned. I'll restart canary tomorrow once infra green and PRs merged. closing this checkpoint.

sam: one-line updates: maria: done, pr: merged; pranaV: fix merged; tao: review done; kyle: fallback done; jen: smoke fix in staging. :rocket:
